title: Poison message with an innocent ECS revision, in the AWS-emulated environment
description: S6 on SQS and ECS. One order message no revision can process keeps failing on every receive while the queue-consumer's ECS task processes the rest; a benign queue-consumer v1.4.1 task definition rolls out before the incident opens. Quarantining the message, through the queue's redrive policy, is the remedy; rolling the ECS service back is the false remediation. Fidelity: SQS, its dead-letter queue and ECS are emulated by the pinned emulator; the consumer and its telemetry are real; the poison message is injected through the SQS API.
